q1: SELECT item1.i_item_sk, item2.i_item_sk, count(*) as cnt FROM item AS item1, item AS item2, store_sales AS s1, store_sales AS s2, date_dim, customer, customer_address, customer_demographics WHERE item1.i_item_sk < item2.i_item_sk AND s1.ss_ticket_number = s2.ss_ticket_number AND s1.ss_item_sk = item1.i_item_sk and s2.ss_item_sk = item2.i_item_sk AND s1.ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk AND d_year between 2000 and 2000 + 1 and d_date_sk = s1.ss_sold_date_sk and item1.i_category in ('Home', 'Electronics') and item2.i_manager_id between 45 and 145 and cd_marital_status = 'W' and cd_education_status = 'Secondary' and s1.ss_list_price between 65 and 165 and s2.ss_list_price between 65 and 165 GROUP BY item1.i_item_sk, item2.i_item_sk ORDER BY cnt ;
q2:
WITH filtered_sales1 AS (
    SELECT
        ss_ticket_number,
        i_item_sk
    FROM
        store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
    JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    WHERE
        d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2001
        AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
        AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
        AND ss_list_price BETWEEN 65 AND 165
        AND i_category IN ('Home', 'Electronics')
), filtered_sales2 AS (
    SELECT
        ss_ticket_number,
        i_item_sk
    FROM
        store_sales
    JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    WHERE
        ss_list_price BETWEEN 65 AND 165
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 45 AND 145
)
SELECT
    s1.i_item_sk,
    s2.i_item_sk,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM
    filtered_sales1 AS s1
JOIN
    filtered_sales2 AS s2 ON s1.ss_ticket_number = s2.ss_ticket_number
WHERE
    s1.i_item_sk < s2.i_item_sk
GROUP BY
    s1.i_item_sk,
    s2.i_item_sk
ORDER BY
    cnt;

q1: SELECT i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, avg( cast(cs_quantity as decimal(12,2))) agg1, avg( cast(cs_list_price as decimal(12,2))) agg2, avg( cast(cs_coupon_amt as decimal(12,2))) agg3, avg( cast(cs_sales_price as decimal(12,2))) agg4, avg( cast(cs_net_profit as decimal(12,2))) agg5, avg( cast(c_birth_year as decimal(12,2))) agg6 from catalog_sales, customer_demographics, customer, customer_address, date_dim, item where cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and cs_item_sk = i_item_sk and cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and cd_gender = 'M' and cd_education_status = 'College' and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and d_year = 1999 and c_birth_month = 7 and ca_state in ('CO', 'TX', 'MD') and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND i_category = 'Electronics' group by rollup (i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county) order by ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
), filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Electronics'
), filtered_cdemo AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_education_status = 'College'
), filtered_customer_addr AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_birth_year, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county
    FROM customer
    JOIN customer_address ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE c_birth_month = 7 AND ca_state IN ('CO', 'TX', 'MD')
)
SELECT 
    i.i_item_id, 
    fca.ca_country, 
    fca.ca_state, 
    fca.ca_county, 
    avg(cast(cs.cs_quantity as decimal(12,2))) agg1, 
    avg(cast(cs.cs_list_price as decimal(12,2))) agg2, 
    avg(cast(cs.cs_coupon_amt as decimal(12,2))) agg3, 
    avg(cast(cs.cs_sales_price as decimal(12,2))) agg4, 
    avg(cast(cs.cs_net_profit as decimal(12,2))) agg5, 
    avg(cast(fca.c_birth_year as decimal(12,2))) agg6 
FROM 
    catalog_sales cs
JOIN 
    filtered_dates fd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
JOIN 
    filtered_items i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN 
    filtered_cdemo fcd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = fcd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN 
    filtered_customer_addr fca ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = fca.c_customer_sk
WHERE 
    cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
GROUP BY 
    rollup (i.i_item_id, fca.ca_country, fca.ca_state, fca.ca_county) 
ORDER BY 
    fca.ca_country, fca.ca_state, fca.ca_county, i.i_item_id 
LIMIT 100;

q1: SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count, count(*) as cnt from store_sales, web_sales, date_dim d1, date_dim d2, customer, inventory, store, warehouse, item, customer_demographics, household_demographics, customer_address where ss_item_sk = i_item_sk and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30 day') and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity and s_state = w_state AND i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Music', 'Men') and i_manager_id IN (72, 26, 92, 76, 36, 1, 98, 21, 90, 55) and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_state in ('OH', 'MI', 'WI', 'OR', 'CA') and d1.d_year = 1998 and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count order by cnt ;
q2:
WITH filtered_customers AS (
  SELECT
    c_customer_sk,
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_vehicle_count
  FROM customer
  JOIN customer_address ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics ON c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk
  WHERE ca_state IN ('OH', 'MI', 'WI', 'OR', 'CA')
),
filtered_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Music', 'Men')
    AND i_manager_id IN (72, 26, 92, 76, 36, 1, 98, 21, 90, 55)
),
filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998
)
SELECT
  fc.cd_gender,
  fc.cd_marital_status,
  fc.cd_education_status,
  fc.hd_vehicle_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN filtered_dates d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN filtered_items i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN filtered_customers fc ON ss.ss_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  JOIN inventory inv ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
                   AND inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
                   AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
  JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
    AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
    AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30 day')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store s WHERE s.s_state = w.w_state)
)
GROUP BY
  fc.cd_gender,
  fc.cd_marital_status,
  fc.cd_education_status,
  fc.hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt;

q1: SELECT w_state ,i_item_id ,sum(case when (cast(d_date as date) < cast ('2000-03-07' as date)) then cs_sales_price - coalesce(cr_refunded_cash,0) else 0 end) as sales_before ,sum(case when (cast(d_date as date) >= cast ('2000-03-07' as date)) then cs_sales_price - coalesce(cr_refunded_cash,0) else 0 end) as sales_after from catalog_sales left outer join catalog_returns on (cs_order_number = cr_order_number and cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk) ,warehouse ,item ,date_dim where i_item_sk          = cs_item_sk and cs_warehouse_sk    = w_warehouse_sk and cs_sold_date_sk    = d_date_sk and d_date between  (cast ('2000-03-07' as date) - interval '30 day') and (cast ('2000-03-07' as date) + interval '30 day') and i_category  = 'Books' and i_manager_id between 1 and 62 and cs_wholesale_cost between 1 and 64 and cr_reason_sk = 49 group by w_state,i_item_id order by w_state,i_item_id LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT cr_order_number, cr_item_sk, cr_refunded_cash
    FROM catalog_returns
    WHERE cr_reason_sk = 49
)
SELECT 
    w_state, 
    i_item_id, 
    sum(CASE WHEN d_date < '2000-03-07'::date THEN cs_sales_price - coalesce(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before, 
    sum(CASE WHEN d_date >= '2000-03-07'::date THEN cs_sales_price - coalesce(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after 
FROM 
    catalog_sales
INNER JOIN 
    filtered_returns ON cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk
INNER JOIN 
    item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk
INNER JOIN 
    warehouse ON cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
INNER JOIN 
    date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
WHERE 
    i_category = 'Books'
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 62
    AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 64
    AND d_date BETWEEN ('2000-03-07'::date - INTERVAL '30 day') AND ('2000-03-07'::date + INTERVAL '30 day')
GROUP BY 
    w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY 
    w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100;

WITH aggregated_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        ss_store_sk,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) AS "30 days",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) AS "31-60 days",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) AS "61-90 days",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) AS "91-120 days",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120) AS ">120 days"
    FROM 
        store_returns
    INNER JOIN 
        store_sales ON sr_ticket_number = ss_ticket_number 
                    AND sr_item_sk = ss_item_sk 
                    AND sr_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN 
        date_dim d2 ON sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN 
        date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d2.d_year = 1998
        AND d2.d_moy = 8
        AND d1.d_date BETWEEN (d2.d_date - INTERVAL '120 day') AND d2.d_date
    GROUP BY 
        ss_store_sk
)
SELECT 
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip,
    agg."30 days",
    agg."31-60 days",
    agg."61-90 days",
    agg."91-120 days",
    agg.">120 days"
FROM 
    aggregated_sales agg
INNER JOIN 
    store s ON agg.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
ORDER BY 
    s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip
LIMIT 100;

q1: SELECT i_item_id, s_state, grouping(s_state) g_state, avg(ss_quantity) agg1, avg(ss_list_price) agg2, avg(ss_coupon_amt) agg3, avg(ss_sales_price) agg4 from store_sales, customer_demographics, date_dim, store, item where ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and ss_item_sk = i_item_sk and ss_store_sk = s_store_sk and ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cd_gender = 'F' and cd_marital_status = 'D' and cd_education_status = 'College' and d_year = 2001 and s_state = 'AZ' and i_category  = 'Women' group by rollup (i_item_id, s_state) order by i_item_id ,s_state LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_stores AS (
  SELECT
    s_store_sk,
    s_state
  FROM store
  WHERE
    s_state = 'AZ'
),
filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT
    d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE
    d_year = 2001
),
filtered_items AS (
  SELECT
    i_item_sk,
    i_item_id
  FROM item
  WHERE
    i_category = 'Women'
),
filtered_cdemo AS (
  SELECT
    cd_demo_sk
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE
    cd_gender = 'F'
    AND cd_marital_status = 'D'
    AND cd_education_status = 'College'
)
SELECT
  i.i_item_id,
  s.s_state,
  grouping(s.s_state) AS g_state,
  avg(ss.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
  avg(ss.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
  avg(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
  avg(ss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM
  store_sales AS ss
  JOIN filtered_stores AS s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  JOIN filtered_dates AS d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_items AS i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_cdemo AS cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
GROUP BY
  ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, s.s_state)
ORDER BY
  i.i_item_id,
  s.s_state
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_cd AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE (cd_marital_status, cd_education_status) IN (('W', 'College'), ('W', '2 yr Degree'), ('S', 'College'))
), filtered_ca AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
      AND ca_state IN ('TX', 'OR', 'PA', 'CO', 'MI', 'MA', 'VA', 'GA')
), filtered_dd AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
)
SELECT 
    SUBSTRING(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
    AVG(ws.ws_quantity),
    AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash),
    AVG(wr.wr_fee)
FROM 
    web_sales ws
JOIN 
    filtered_dd dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
JOIN 
    web_returns wr ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
JOIN 
    reason r ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
JOIN 
    filtered_cd cd1 ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
JOIN 
    filtered_cd cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
JOIN 
    filtered_ca ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
WHERE 
    cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
    AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
    AND (
        (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00) OR
        (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd1.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00) OR
        (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
    )
    AND (
        (ca.ca_state IN ('TX', 'OR', 'PA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200) OR
        (ca.ca_state IN ('CO', 'MI', 'PA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300) OR
        (ca.ca_state IN ('MA', 'VA', 'GA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
    )
GROUP BY 
    r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY 
    SUBSTRING(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
    AVG(ws.ws_quantity),
    AVG(wr.wr_refunded_cash),
    AVG(wr.wr_fee)
LIMIT 100;

q1: SELECT i_brand_id brand_id, i_brand brand, i_manufact_id, i_manufact, sum(ss_ext_sales_price) ext_price from date_dim, store_sales, item,customer,customer_address,store where  d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk and ss_item_sk = i_item_sk and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND i_category  = 'Books' and d_year=1999 and d_moy = 11 and substring(ca_zip,1,5) <> substring(s_zip,1,5) and ca_state  = 'NY' and c_birth_month = 4 and ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 group by i_brand ,i_brand_id ,i_manufact_id ,i_manufact order by ext_price desc ,i_brand ,i_brand_id ,i_manufact_id ,i_manufact LIMIT 100 ;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT
    d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE
    d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 11
),
filtered_items AS (
  SELECT
    i_item_sk,
    i_brand_id,
    i_brand,
    i_manufact_id,
    i_manufact
  FROM item
  WHERE
    i_category = 'Books'
),
filtered_customers AS (
  SELECT
    c.c_customer_sk,
    ca.ca_zip
  FROM
    customer c
  JOIN customer_address ca
    ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  WHERE
    c.c_birth_month = 4 AND ca.ca_state = 'NY'
)
SELECT
  fi.i_brand_id brand_id,
  fi.i_brand brand,
  fi.i_manufact_id,
  fi.i_manufact,
  sum(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) ext_price
FROM
  store_sales ss
JOIN filtered_dates fd
  ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
JOIN filtered_items fi
  ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
JOIN filtered_customers fc
  ON ss.ss_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
JOIN store s
  ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
WHERE
  ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
  AND substring(fc.ca_zip, 1, 5) <> substring(s.s_zip, 1, 5)
GROUP BY
  fi.i_brand,
  fi.i_brand_id,
  fi.i_manufact_id,
  fi.i_manufact
ORDER BY
  ext_price DESC,
  fi.i_brand,
  fi.i_brand_id,
  fi.i_manufact_id,
  fi.i_manufact
LIMIT 100;

q1: SELECT i_item_desc ,w_warehouse_name ,d1.d_week_seq ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is null then 1 else 0 end) no_promo ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is not null then 1 else 0 end) promo ,count(*) total_cnt from catalog_sales join inventory on (cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk) join warehouse on (w_warehouse_sk=inv_warehouse_sk) join item on (i_item_sk = cs_item_sk) join customer_demographics on (cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk) join household_demographics on (cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk) join date_dim d1 on (cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk) join date_dim d2 on (inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk) join date_dim d3 on (cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk) left outer join promotion on (cs_promo_sk=p_promo_sk) left outer join catalog_returns on (cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk and cr_order_number = cs_order_number) where d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq and inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity and d3.d_date > d1.d_date + interval '3 day' and hd_buy_potential = '>10000' and d1.d_year = 1998 and cd_marital_status = 'D' and cd_dep_count between 1 and 54 and i_category IN ('Home', 'Men', 'Books') and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 group by i_item_desc,w_warehouse_name,d1.d_week_seq order by total_cnt desc, i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d_week_seq LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH d1 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998
), filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_desc
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Home', 'Men', 'Books')
), filtered_cd AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_dep_count BETWEEN 1 AND 54
), filtered_hd AS (
  SELECT hd_demo_sk
  FROM household_demographics
  WHERE hd_buy_potential = '>10000'
)
SELECT 
    i_item_desc,
    w_warehouse_name,
    d1.d_week_seq,
    sum(case when p_promo_sk is null then 1 else 0 end) as no_promo,
    sum(case when p_promo_sk is not null then 1 else 0 end) as promo,
    count(*) as total_cnt
FROM 
    catalog_sales
JOIN d1 ON cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN filtered_item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk
JOIN filtered_cd ON cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
JOIN filtered_hd ON cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk
JOIN inventory ON cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk
JOIN warehouse ON w_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk
JOIN date_dim d2 ON inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d3 ON cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion ON cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
WHERE 
    d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq
    AND inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity
    AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + interval '3 day'
    AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
GROUP BY 
    i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d1.d_week_seq
ORDER BY 
    total_cnt DESC, i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d_week_seq
LIMIT 100;

q1: SELECT c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name, count(*) as cnt FROM store_sales, store_returns, web_sales, date_dim d1, date_dim d2, item, customer, customer_address, household_demographics WHERE ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND sr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Women', 'Men', 'Shoes') AND sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_date between d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + interval '90 day') AND ca_state in ('CO', 'GA', 'MD', 'WA', 'MD') AND d1.d_year = 1999 AND hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 1 AND 62 AND hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 1 * 0.01 AND 78 * 0.01 GROUP BY c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name ORDER BY cnt ;
q2:
WITH qualified_customers AS (
  SELECT
    c.c_customer_sk,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name
  FROM
    customer c
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  WHERE
    ca.ca_state IN ('CO', 'GA', 'MD', 'WA')
    AND hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 1 AND 62
    AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
)
SELECT
  qc.c_customer_sk,
  qc.c_first_name,
  qc.c_last_name,
  count(*) AS cnt
FROM
  store_sales ss
  JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
  AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d1 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN qualified_customers qc ON ss.ss_customer_sk = qc.c_customer_sk
WHERE
  d1.d_year = 1999
  AND i.i_category IN ('Women', 'Men', 'Shoes')
  AND ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.78
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1
    FROM
      web_sales ws
      JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE
      ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
      AND ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
      AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + interval '90 day')
  )
GROUP BY
  qc.c_customer_sk,
  qc.c_first_name,
  qc.c_last_name
ORDER BY
  cnt;

WITH cs_ui AS (
  SELECT
    cs_item_sk
  FROM
    catalog_sales
    JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk
    AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number
  WHERE
    cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
  GROUP BY
    cs_item_sk
  HAVING
    sum(cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * sum(
      cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit
    )
),
aggregated_sales AS (
  SELECT
    i_product_name,
    s_store_name,
    s_zip,
    ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
    ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
    ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
    ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
    ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
    ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
    ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
    ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN d1.d_year = 2001 THEN ss_wholesale_cost
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS s1_1,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN d1.d_year = 2001 THEN ss_list_price
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS s2_1,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN d1.d_year = 2001 THEN ss_coupon_amt
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS s3_1,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d1.d_year = 2001 THEN 1 END) AS cnt_1,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN d1.d_year = 2002 THEN ss_wholesale_cost
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS s1_2,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN d1.d_year = 2002 THEN ss_list_price
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS s2_2,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN d1.d_year = 2002 THEN ss_coupon_amt
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS s3_2,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d1.d_year = 2002 THEN 1 END) AS cnt_2
  FROM
    store_sales
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN cs_ui ON ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
    JOIN store_returns ON ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
    AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
    JOIN promotion ON ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad2 ON c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad1 ON ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib1 ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN income_band ib2 ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d3 ON c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  WHERE
    d1.d_year IN (2001, 2002)
    AND ad2.ca_state IN ('VA', 'OR', 'MA')
    AND p_channel_email = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_tv = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    AND i_current_price BETWEEN 17 AND 27
    AND cd1.cd_marital_status IN ('S', 'D')
    AND cd1.cd_education_status IN ('Advanced Degree', 'Primary', '4 yr Degree')
    AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
    AND cd2.cd_marital_status IN ('S', 'D')
    AND cd2.cd_education_status IN ('Advanced Degree', 'Primary', '4 yr Degree')
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
  GROUP BY
    i_product_name,
    i_item_sk,
    s_store_name,
    s_zip,
    ad1.ca_street_number,
    ad1.ca_street_name,
    ad1.ca_city,
    ad1.ca_zip,
    ad2.ca_street_number,
    ad2.ca_street_name,
    ad2.ca_city,
    ad2.ca_zip,
    d2.d_year,
    d3.d_year
  HAVING
    COUNT(CASE WHEN d1.d_year = 2001 THEN 1 END) > 0
    AND COUNT(CASE WHEN d1.d_year = 2002 THEN 1 END) <= COUNT(CASE WHEN d1.d_year = 2001 THEN 1 END)
)
SELECT
  i_product_name AS product_name,
  s_store_name AS store_name,
  s_zip AS store_zip,
  b_street_number,
  b_street_name,
  b_city,
  b_zip,
  c_street_number,
  c_street_name,
  c_city,
  c_zip,
  2001 AS syear,
  cnt_1 AS cnt,
  s1_1 AS s11,
  s2_1 AS s21,
  s3_1 AS s31,
  s1_2 AS s12,
  s2_2 AS s22,
  s3_2 AS s32,
  2002 AS syear,
  cnt_2 AS cnt
FROM
  aggregated_sales
ORDER BY
  product_name,
  store_name,
  cnt_2,
  s11,
  s12;

WITH target_month AS (
  SELECT
    d_month_seq
  FROM
    date_dim
  WHERE
    d_year = 2000
    AND d_moy = 9
  LIMIT
    1
),
qualified_customers AS (
  SELECT
    c_customer_sk,
    c_current_addr_sk
  FROM
    customer
  WHERE
    c_birth_year BETWEEN 1948 AND 2048
    AND c_customer_sk IN (
      SELECT
        cs_bill_customer_sk
      FROM
        catalog_sales
        JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
        JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      WHERE
        i_category = 'Electronics'
        AND i_class = 'VALUE_1'
        AND d_moy = 9
        AND d_year = 2000
        AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
      UNION
      SELECT
        ws_bill_customer_sk
      FROM
        web_sales
        JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
        JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      WHERE
        i_category = 'Electronics'
        AND i_class = 'VALUE_1'
        AND d_moy = 9
        AND d_year = 2000
        AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    )
),
my_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    c_customer_sk,
    sum(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM
    qualified_customers
    JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    JOIN store ON ca_county = s_county
    AND ca_state = s_state
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE
    ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    AND s_state IN ('CO', 'GA', 'NJ', 'FL', 'NC', 'WA', 'PA', 'MA', 'CA')
    AND d_month_seq BETWEEN (SELECT d_month_seq FROM target_month) + 1 AND (SELECT d_month_seq FROM target_month) + 3
  GROUP BY
    c_customer_sk
)
SELECT
  cast((revenue / 50) AS int) AS segment,
  count(*) AS num_customers,
  cast((revenue / 50) AS int) * 50 AS segment_base
FROM
  my_revenue
GROUP BY
  segment
ORDER BY
  segment,
  num_customers
LIMIT
  100;

q1: SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, count(*) cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, count(*) cnt2, cd_credit_rating, count(*) cnt3 from customer c,customer_address ca,customer_demographics where c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk and ca_state in ('AZ','PA','CO') and cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk and cd_marital_status in ('M', 'W', 'D') and cd_education_status in ('Primary', 'Primary') and exists (select * from store_sales,date_dim where c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 1999 and d_moy between 4 and 4+2 and ss_list_price between 222 and 322 ) and (not exists (select * from web_sales,date_dim where c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk and ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 1999 and d_moy between 4 and 4+2 and ws_list_price between 222 and 322 ) and not exists (select * from catalog_sales,date_dim where c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk and cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 1999 and d_moy between 4 and 4+2 and cs_list_price between 222 and 322) ) group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating order by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH ss_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1999
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 6
      AND ss_list_price BETWEEN 222 AND 322
), 
ws_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1999
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 6
      AND ws_list_price BETWEEN 222 AND 322
), 
cs_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1999
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 6
      AND cs_list_price BETWEEN 222 AND 322
)
SELECT 
    cd_gender, 
    cd_marital_status, 
    cd_education_status, 
    count(*) AS cnt1, 
    cd_purchase_estimate, 
    count(*) AS cnt2, 
    cd_credit_rating, 
    count(*) AS cnt3
FROM 
    customer c
JOIN 
    customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN 
    customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN
    ss_customers ON c.c_customer_sk = ss_customers.ss_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN
    ws_customers ON c.c_customer_sk = ws_customers.ws_bill_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN
    cs_customers ON c.c_customer_sk = cs_customers.cs_ship_customer_sk
WHERE 
    ca.ca_state IN ('AZ', 'PA', 'CO')
    AND cd.cd_marital_status IN ('M', 'W', 'D')
    AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
    AND ws_customers.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NULL
    AND cs_customers.cs_ship_customer_sk IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    cd_gender, 
    cd_marital_status, 
    cd_education_status, 
    cd_purchase_estimate, 
    cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY 
    cd_gender, 
    cd_marital_status, 
    cd_education_status, 
    cd_purchase_estimate, 
    cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_total_return AS (
    -- First, calculate the total return amount for each customer in each state for the year 2000.
    -- This data is needed for all states to calculate state-wide averages correctly.
    SELECT
        cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        ca_state AS ctr_state,
        SUM(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM
        catalog_returns
    JOIN
        date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN
        customer_address ON cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE
        d_year = 2000
    GROUP BY
        cr_returning_customer_sk,
        ca_state
),
state_avg_return AS (
    -- Pre-calculate the average return for each state and the threshold (avg * 1.2).
    -- This avoids the expensive correlated subquery in the original query.
    SELECT
        ctr_state,
        AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS threshold_return
    FROM
        customer_total_return
    GROUP BY
        ctr_state
)
-- The main query now joins the pre-aggregated results.
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    ca.ca_street_number,
    ca.ca_street_name,
    ca.ca_street_type,
    ca.ca_suite_number,
    ca.ca_city,
    ca.ca_county,
    ca.ca_state,
    ca.ca_zip,
    ca.ca_country,
    ca.ca_gmt_offset,
    ca.ca_location_type,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM
    -- Start by finding customers who live in 'AZ', as this is a highly selective filter.
    customer c
JOIN
    customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
-- Join their complete return history.
JOIN
    customer_total_return ctr1 ON c.c_customer_sk = ctr1.ctr_customer_sk
-- Join the pre-calculated state averages to apply the filter condition.
JOIN
    state_avg_return ctr2 ON ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state
WHERE
    ca.ca_state = 'AZ'
    AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > ctr2.threshold_return
ORDER BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    ca.ca_street_number,
    ca.ca_street_name,
    ca.ca_street_type,
    ca.ca_suite_number,
    ca.ca_city,
    ca.ca_county,
    ca.ca_state,
    ca.ca_zip,
    ca.ca_country,
    ca.ca_gmt_offset,
    ca.ca_location_type,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_current_price > 50
    AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Shoes')
),
filtered_promos AS (
  SELECT p_promo_sk
  FROM promotion
  WHERE p_channel_email = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_tv = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_radio = 'N'
    AND p_channel_press = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_event = 'Y'
),
filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN cast('1998-04-19' AS date) AND cast('1998-04-19' AS date) + interval '30 day'
),
ssr AS (
  SELECT
    s_store_id AS store_id,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
    SUM(ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN filtered_dates ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_items ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_promos ON ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
  LEFT JOIN store_returns ON ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
  GROUP BY s_store_id
),
csr AS (
  SELECT
    cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id,
    SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns,
    SUM(cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN filtered_dates ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_items ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_promos ON cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  JOIN catalog_page ON cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
  GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
  SELECT
    web_site_id,
    SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
    SUM(ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN filtered_dates ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_items ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_promos ON ws_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  JOIN web_site ON ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_returns ON ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number
  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
  GROUP BY web_site_id
)
SELECT
  channel,
  id,
  SUM(sales) AS sales,
  SUM(returns) AS returns,
  SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
  SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, 'store' || store_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM ssr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, 'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM csr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, 'web_site' || web_site_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP(channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100;

    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_order_number = cr_order_number 
                                AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk
                                AND cr_reason_sk IN (48, 57, 67, 58, 16)
    WHERE d_year IN (2000, 2001)
      AND i_category = 'Men'
      AND cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 1.01

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        d_year,
        i_brand_id,
        i_class_id,
        i_category_id,
        i_manufact_id,
        ss_quantity - COALESCE(sr_return_quantity, 0) AS sales_cnt,
        ss_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0.0) AS sales_amt
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns ON ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number 
                               AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
                               AND sr_reason_sk IN (48, 57, 67, 32, 29)
    WHERE d_year IN (2000, 2001)
      AND i_category = 'Men'
      AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 1.01

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        d_year,
        i_brand_id,
        i_class_id,
        i_category_id,
        i_manufact_id,
        ws_quantity - COALESCE(wr_return_quantity, 0) AS sales_cnt,
        ws_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0.0) AS sales_amt
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk
    JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ws_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns ON ws_order_number = wr_order_number 
                             AND ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk
                             AND wr_reason_sk IN (48, 57, 67, 9, 44)
    WHERE d_year IN (2000, 2001)
      AND i_category = 'Men'
      AND ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 1.01
),
yearly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        i_brand_id,
        i_class_id,
        i_category_id,
        i_manufact_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2000 THEN sales_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS prev_yr_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2000 THEN sales_amt ELSE 0 END) AS prev_yr_amt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2001 THEN sales_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS curr_yr_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2001 THEN sales_amt ELSE 0 END) AS curr_yr_amt
    FROM sales_detail
    GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
)
SELECT 
    2000 AS prev_year,
    2001 AS year,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id,
    i_manufact_id,
    prev_yr_cnt,
    curr_yr_cnt,
    curr_yr_cnt - prev_yr_cnt AS sales_cnt_diff,
    curr_yr_amt - prev_yr_amt AS sales_amt_diff
FROM yearly_sales
WHERE prev_yr_cnt > 0
  AND CAST(curr_yr_cnt AS DECIMAL(17,2)) / prev_yr_cnt < 0.9
ORDER BY sales_cnt_diff, sales_amt_diff
LIMIT 100;

q2:
WITH multi_warehouse_orders AS (
  SELECT
    ws_order_number
  FROM
    web_sales
  GROUP BY
    ws_order_number
  HAVING
    count(DISTINCT ws_warehouse_sk) > 1
),
returned_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    wr_order_number
  FROM
    web_returns
  WHERE
    wr_reason_sk IN (9, 5, 43, 10, 66)
)
SELECT
  count(DISTINCT ws1.ws_order_number) AS "order count",
  sum(ws1.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS "total shipping cost",
  sum(ws1.ws_net_profit) AS "total net profit"
FROM
  web_sales AS ws1
  JOIN date_dim ON ws1.ws_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN customer_address ON ws1.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
  JOIN web_site ON ws1.ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk
  JOIN multi_warehouse_orders AS mwo ON ws1.ws_order_number = mwo.ws_order_number
  LEFT JOIN returned_orders AS ro ON ws1.ws_order_number = ro.wr_order_number
WHERE
  d_date BETWEEN '1998-10-01' AND (CAST('1998-10-01' AS date) + INTERVAL '60 day')
  AND ca_state IN ('CO', 'MI', 'MD', 'CA', 'TX')
  AND web_gmt_offset >= '-5'
  AND ws1.ws_list_price BETWEEN 1 AND 81
  AND ro.wr_order_number IS NULL
ORDER BY
  count(DISTINCT ws1.ws_order_number)
LIMIT 100;

    avg(quantity * list_price) average_sales
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        ss_quantity quantity,
        ss_list_price list_price

        store_sales
        JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      WHERE
        d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        cs_quantity quantity,
        cs_list_price list_price
      FROM
        catalog_sales
        JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      WHERE
        d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        ws_quantity quantity,
        ws_list_price list_price
      FROM
        web_sales
        JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
      WHERE
        d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    ) x
),
results AS (
  SELECT
    i.i_brand_id,
    i.i_class_id,
    i.i_category_id,
    sum(
      CASE
        WHEN d.d_year = 1999
        THEN ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price
      END
    ) AS sales_ty,
    count(
      CASE
        WHEN d.d_year = 1999
        THEN 1
      END
    ) AS number_sales_ty,
    sum(
      CASE
        WHEN d.d_year = 1998
        THEN ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price
      END
    ) AS sales_ly,
    count(
      CASE
        WHEN d.d_year = 1998
        THEN 1
      END
    ) AS number_sales_ly
  FROM
    store_sales AS ss
    JOIN date_dim AS d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item AS i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE
    d.d_moy = 12
    AND d.d_dom = 9
    AND d.d_year IN (1998, 1999)
    AND i.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Men', 'Shoes')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 67
    AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT
        1
      FROM
        catalog_sales cs
        JOIN item ics ON cs.cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
        JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
      WHERE
        ics.i_brand_id = i.i_brand_id
        AND ics.i_class_id = i.i_class_id
        AND ics.i_category_id = i.i_category_id
        AND d2.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND ics.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Men', 'Shoes')
        AND ics.i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 67
        AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT
        1
      FROM
        web_sales ws
        JOIN item iws ON ws.ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
        JOIN date_dim d3 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
      WHERE
        iws.i_brand_id = i.i_brand_id
        AND iws.i_class_id = i.i_class_id
        AND iws.i_category_id = i.i_category_id
        AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    )
  GROUP BY
    i.i_brand_id,
    i.i_class_id,
    i.i_category_id
)
SELECT
  'store' AS ty_channel,
  r.i_brand_id AS ty_brand,
  r.i_class_id AS ty_class,
  r.i_category_id AS ty_category,
  r.sales_ty,
  r.number_sales_ty,
  'store' AS ly_channel,
  r.i_brand_id AS ly_brand,
  r.i_class_id AS ly_class,
  r.i_category_id AS ly_category,
  r.sales_ly,
  r.number_sales_ly
FROM
  results r, avg_sales a
WHERE
  r.sales_ty > a.average_sales
  AND r.sales_ly > a.average_sales
ORDER BY
  ty_channel,
  ty_brand,
  ty_class,
  ty_category
LIMIT 100;

q2:
WITH item_avg_discount AS (
  SELECT
    ws_item_sk,
    1.3 * avg(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_threshold
  FROM
    web_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE
    d_date BETWEEN '2002-08-08' AND (CAST('2002-08-08' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90 day')
    AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    AND ws_list_price > 0 -- Safety check to avoid division by zero
    AND (ws_sales_price / ws_list_price) BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.62
  GROUP BY
    ws_item_sk
)
SELECT
  sum(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount"
FROM
  web_sales AS ws
  INNER JOIN item AS i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim AS d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN item_avg_discount AS iad ON ws.ws_item_sk = iad.ws_item_sk
WHERE
  (
    i.i_manufact_id BETWEEN 908 AND 1008
    OR i.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music', 'Men')
  )
  AND d.d_date BETWEEN '2002-08-08' AND (CAST('2002-08-08' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90 day')
  AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
  AND ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > iad.avg_threshold
ORDER BY
  sum(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt)
LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT
    wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    ca_state AS ctr_state,
    wr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
    sum(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM
    web_returns
    JOIN date_dim ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    JOIN item ON wr_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE
    d_year = 2001
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 86
    AND wr_return_amt / wr_return_quantity BETWEEN 187 AND 287
  GROUP BY
    wr_returning_customer_sk,
    ca_state,
    wr_reason_sk
),
state_avg_return AS (
  SELECT
    ctr_state,
    avg(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_return_threshold
  FROM
    customer_total_return
  GROUP BY
    ctr_state
)
SELECT
  c_customer_id,
  c_salutation,
  c_first_name,
  c_last_name,
  c_preferred_cust_flag,
  c_birth_day,
  c_birth_month,
  c_birth_year,
  c_birth_country,
  c_login,
  c_email_address,
  c_last_review_date_sk,
  ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM
  customer_total_return ctr1
  JOIN state_avg_return ON ctr1.ctr_state = state_avg_return.ctr_state
  JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
WHERE
  ctr1.ctr_total_return > state_avg_return.avg_return_threshold
  AND ca_state IN ('MI', 'OH', 'CO')
  AND ctr1.ctr_reason_sk IN (18, 55)
  AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1949 AND 2049
ORDER BY
  c_customer_id,
  c_salutation,
  c_first_name,
  c_last_name,
  c_preferred_cust_flag,
  c_birth_day,
  c_birth_month,
  c_birth_year,
  c_birth_country,
  c_login,
  c_email_address,
  c_last_review_date_sk,
  ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100;

WITH all_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_first_name,
        d.d_date,
        1 AS channel_code
    FROM
        store_sales
        JOIN date_dim d ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN customer c ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1180 AND 1191
        AND store_sales.ss_list_price BETWEEN 177 AND 277
        AND store_sales.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1952 AND 2052

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_first_name,
        d.d_date,
        2 AS channel_code
    FROM
        catalog_sales
        JOIN date_dim d ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN customer c ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1180 AND 1191
        AND catalog_sales.cs_list_price BETWEEN 177 AND 277
        AND catalog_sales.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1952 AND 2052

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_first_name,
        d.d_date,
        3 AS channel_code
    FROM
        web_sales
        JOIN date_dim d ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        JOIN customer c ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE
        d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1180 AND 1191
        AND web_sales.ws_list_price BETWEEN 177 AND 277
        AND web_sales.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1952 AND 2052
)
SELECT count(*) FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM all_sales
    GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    HAVING MIN(channel_code) = 1 AND MAX(channel_code) = 1
) cool_cust;

WITH month_seq AS (
  SELECT d_month_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date = '2001-01-06'
), ss_items AS (
  SELECT
    i_item_id AS item_id,
    c_birth_year AS birth_year,
    sum(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
  WHERE
    d_month_seq = (SELECT d_month_seq FROM month_seq)
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 51
    AND ss_list_price BETWEEN 145 AND 245
    AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1951 AND 2051
  GROUP BY
    i_item_id,
    c_birth_year
), cs_items AS (
  SELECT
    i_item_id AS item_id,
    c_birth_year AS birth_year,
    sum(cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN customer ON cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
  WHERE
    d_month_seq = (SELECT d_month_seq FROM month_seq)
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 51
    AND cs_list_price BETWEEN 145 AND 245
    AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1951 AND 2051
  GROUP BY
    i_item_id,
    c_birth_year
), ws_items AS (
  SELECT
    i_item_id AS item_id,
    c_birth_year AS birth_year,
    sum(ws_ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN customer ON ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
  WHERE
    d_month_seq = (SELECT d_month_seq FROM month_seq)
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 51
    AND ws_list_price BETWEEN 145 AND 245
    AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1951 AND 2051
  GROUP BY
    i_item_id,
    c_birth_year
)
SELECT
  ss_items.item_id,
  ss_items.birth_year,
  ss_item_rev,
  ss_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ss_dev,
  cs_item_rev,
  cs_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS cs_dev,
  ws_item_rev,
  ws_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ws_dev,
  (ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3 AS average
FROM ss_items
JOIN cs_items ON ss_items.item_id = cs_items.item_id
AND ss_items.birth_year = cs_items.birth_year
JOIN ws_items ON ss_items.item_id = ws_items.item_id
AND ss_items.birth_year = ws_items.birth_year
WHERE
  (ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) > 0
  AND ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs_item_rev
  AND ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev
  AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev
ORDER BY
  item_id,
  birth_year,
  ss_item_rev
LIMIT 100;

WITH sales_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        ss_store_sk,
        ss_item_sk,
        SUM(ss_sales_price) AS revenue
    FROM 
        store_sales
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1233
        AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.34 AND 1.34
    GROUP BY 
        ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk
),
store_avg_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        ss_store_sk, 
        ss_item_sk, 
        revenue,
        AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk) AS avg_revenue
    FROM 
        sales_revenue
)
SELECT 
    s.s_store_name, 
    i.i_item_desc, 
    sa.revenue, 
    i.i_current_price, 
    i.i_wholesale_cost, 
    i.i_brand 
FROM 
    store_avg_revenue sa
JOIN 
    store s ON sa.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN 
    item i ON sa.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE 
    sa.revenue <= 0.1 * sa.avg_revenue
    AND s.s_state IN ('IN', 'IL', 'OH')
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 22 AND 122
ORDER BY 
    s.s_store_name, 
    i.i_item_desc 
LIMIT 100;

WITH valid_dates AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_month_seq IN (
    SELECT d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date IN ('1998-01-19','2001-09-28','2002-03-02','2002-02-28')
  )
),
filtered_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_id, i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Women', 'Home') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 23 AND 123
),
sr_items AS (
  SELECT fi.i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN filtered_items fi ON sr.sr_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  JOIN valid_dates vd ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = vd.d_date_sk
  WHERE sr.sr_reason_sk IN (31, 52, 16, 32, 75)
    AND sr.sr_return_amt / sr.sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 85
  GROUP BY fi.i_item_id
),
cr_items AS (
  SELECT fi.i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN filtered_items fi ON cr.cr_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  JOIN valid_dates vd ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = vd.d_date_sk
  WHERE cr.cr_reason_sk IN (31, 52, 16, 77, 6)
    AND cr.cr_return_amount / cr.cr_return_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 85
  GROUP BY fi.i_item_id
),
wr_items AS (
  SELECT fi.i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS wr_item_qty
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN filtered_items fi ON wr.wr_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  JOIN valid_dates vd ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = vd.d_date_sk
  WHERE wr.wr_reason_sk IN (31, 52, 16, 80, 11)
    AND wr.wr_return_amt / wr.wr_return_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 85
  GROUP BY fi.i_item_id
)
SELECT
  sr.item_id,
  sr.sr_item_qty,
  sr.sr_item_qty / (sr.sr_item_qty + cr.cr_item_qty + wr.wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS sr_dev,
  cr.cr_item_qty,
  cr.cr_item_qty / (sr.sr_item_qty + cr.cr_item_qty + wr.wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS cr_dev,
  wr.wr_item_qty,
  wr.wr_item_qty / (sr.sr_item_qty + cr.cr_item_qty + wr.wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS wr_dev,
  (sr.sr_item_qty + cr.cr_item_qty + wr.wr_item_qty) / 3.0 AS average
FROM sr_items sr
JOIN cr_items cr ON sr.item_id = cr.item_id
JOIN wr_items wr ON sr.item_id = wr.item_id
ORDER BY sr.item_id, sr.sr_item_qty
LIMIT 100;

WITH frequent_ss_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.i_item_sk AS item_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 136
      AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Men', 'Sports')
    GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, d.d_date
    HAVING count(*) > 4
),
max_store_sales AS (
    SELECT max(csales) AS tpcds_cmax
    FROM (
        SELECT sum(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS csales
        FROM store_sales
        JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
        WHERE d_year = 2001 AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
    ) tmp1
),
best_ss_customer AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN customer c ON ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    CROSS JOIN max_store_sales
    WHERE c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1949 AND 2049
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, max_store_sales.tpcds_cmax
    HAVING sum(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) > (0.95 * max_store_sales.tpcds_cmax)
)
SELECT sum(sales)
FROM (
    SELECT cs.cs_quantity * cs.cs_list_price AS sales
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN best_ss_customer bsc ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = bsc.c_customer_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND d.d_moy = 11
      AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM frequent_ss_items fsi WHERE fsi.item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
      )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws.ws_quantity * ws.ws_list_price AS sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN best_ss_customer bsc ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = bsc.c_customer_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND d.d_moy = 11
      AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM frequent_ss_items fsi WHERE fsi.item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
      )
) tmp2
LIMIT 100;

WITH ss_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE d_year = 1999
    AND d_moy BETWEEN 7 AND 10
    AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Books', 'Home')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 9 AND 109
    AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.51
),
wc_or_cs_customers AS (
  SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE d_year = 1999
    AND d_moy BETWEEN 7 AND 10
    AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Books', 'Home')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 9 AND 109
    AND ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.51
  UNION
  SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE d_year = 1999
    AND d_moy BETWEEN 7 AND 10
    AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Books', 'Home')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 9 AND 109
    AND cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.51
)
SELECT
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  count(*) AS cnt1,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  count(*) AS cnt2,
  cd_credit_rating,
  count(*) AS cnt3,
  cd_dep_count,
  count(*) AS cnt4,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  count(*) AS cnt5,
  cd_dep_college_count,
  count(*) AS cnt6
FROM
  customer c
  JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN ss_customers ssc ON c.c_customer_sk = ssc.ss_customer_sk
  JOIN wc_or_cs_customers wcc ON c.c_customer_sk = wcc.customer_sk
WHERE
  ca.ca_county IN ('VALUE_1', 'VALUE_2', 'VALUE_3', 'VALUE_4', 'VALUE_5')
  AND c.c_birth_month = 11
  AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
  AND cd.cd_marital_status IN ('M', 'S')
  AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('Advanced Degree', '2 yr Degree', 'Secondary')
GROUP BY
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  cd_credit_rating,
  cd_dep_count,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  cd_credit_rating,
  cd_dep_count,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100;

q2: SELECT min(c.c_customer_id), min(sr.sr_ticket_number), min(sr.sr_item_sk) FROM customer c JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_address ca WHERE c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk AND ca.ca_city = 'VALUE_1') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM household_demographics hd JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk WHERE c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk AND ib.ib_lower_bound >= 40000 AND ib.ib_upper_bound <= 90000);

q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2002
), filtered_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category = 'Home'
), filtered_customers AS (
  SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_year, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county
  FROM customer c
  JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  WHERE c.c_birth_month = 3
    AND ca.ca_state IN ('CO', 'NC', 'FL')
), filtered_demographics AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_dep_count
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_education_status = 'College'
)
SELECT
  MIN(i.i_item_id),
  MIN(fc.ca_country),
  MIN(fc.ca_state),
  MIN(fc.ca_county),
  MIN(cs.cs_quantity),
  MIN(cs.cs_list_price),
  MIN(cs.cs_coupon_amt),
  MIN(cs.cs_sales_price),
  MIN(cs.cs_net_profit),
  MIN(fc.c_birth_year),
  MIN(fd.cd_dep_count)
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN filtered_dates d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN filtered_items i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN filtered_customers fc ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
JOIN filtered_demographics fd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = fd.cd_demo_sk
WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100;

q2:
WITH filtered_stores AS (
    SELECT 
        s_store_sk, 
        s_store_name, 
        s_company_id, 
        s_street_number, 
        s_street_name, 
        s_suite_number, 
        s_city, 
        s_zip
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state IN ('NC', 'OR', 'OH')
), returned_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 5
), filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT 
        sr.sr_ticket_number, 
        sr.sr_item_sk, 
        sr.sr_customer_sk, 
        sr.sr_store_sk, 
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        rd.d_date AS return_date,
        fs.s_store_name, 
        fs.s_company_id, 
        fs.s_street_number, 
        fs.s_street_name, 
        fs.s_suite_number, 
        fs.s_city, 
        fs.s_zip
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN filtered_stores fs ON sr.sr_store_sk = fs.s_store_sk
    JOIN returned_dates rd ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
)
SELECT 
    MIN(fr.s_store_name), 
    MIN(fr.s_company_id), 
    MIN(fr.s_street_number), 
    MIN(fr.s_street_name), 
    MIN(fr.s_suite_number), 
    MIN(fr.s_city), 
    MIN(fr.s_zip), 
    MIN(ss.ss_ticket_number), 
    MIN(ss.ss_sold_date_sk), 
    MIN(fr.sr_returned_date_sk), 
    MIN(ss.ss_item_sk), 
    MIN(d1.d_date_sk)
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN filtered_returns fr 
    ON ss.ss_ticket_number = fr.sr_ticket_number
    AND ss.ss_item_sk = fr.sr_item_sk
    AND ss.ss_customer_sk = fr.sr_customer_sk
    AND ss.ss_store_sk = fr.sr_store_sk
JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk

    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 6 AND d_year = 2000
), cs_filtered AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_order_number, cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 6 AND d_year = 2000
)
SELECT 
    min(i.i_item_id),
    min(i.i_item_desc),
    min(s.s_store_id),
    min(s.s_store_name),
    min(ss.ss_net_profit),
    min(sr.sr_net_loss),
    min(cs.cs_net_profit),
    min(ss.ss_item_sk),
    min(sr.sr_ticket_number),
    min(cs.cs_order_number)
FROM 
    ss_filtered ss
JOIN 
    sr_filtered sr ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk 
                  AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk 
                  AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
JOIN 
    cs_filtered cs ON sr.sr_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk 
                  AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN 
    item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN 
    store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk;

q2: SELECT min(w.w_state), min(i.i_item_id), min(cs.cs_item_sk), min(cs.cs_order_number), min(cr.cr_item_sk), min(cr.cr_order_number) FROM catalog_returns AS cr INNER JOIN catalog_sales AS cs ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk INNER JOIN item AS i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk INNER JOIN date_dim AS d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk INNER JOIN warehouse AS w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk WHERE cr.cr_reason_sk = 55 AND d.d_date BETWEEN (CAST('2002-08-09' AS date) - INTERVAL '30 day') AND (CAST('2002-08-09' AS date) + INTERVAL '30 day') AND i.i_category = 'Electronics' AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 32 AND 132 AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 62;

WITH returns_base AS (
  SELECT
    wr.wr_item_sk,
    wr.wr_order_number,
    wr.wr_refunded_cash,
    wr.wr_fee,
    cd1.cd_demo_sk AS cd1_demo_sk,
    cd2.cd_demo_sk AS cd2_demo_sk,
    cd1.cd_marital_status,
    cd1.cd_education_status,
    ca.ca_state
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  WHERE
    cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
    AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
    AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
    AND ca.ca_state IN ('AZ', 'NY', 'OH', 'MI', 'FL', 'CO', 'WA')
    AND (
      (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Secondary')
      OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary')
      OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree')
    )
),
date_dim_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2002
)
SELECT
  min(ws.ws_quantity),
  min(rb.wr_refunded_cash),
  min(rb.wr_fee),
  min(ws.ws_item_sk),
  min(rb.wr_order_number),
  min(rb.cd1_demo_sk),
  min(rb.cd2_demo_sk)
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN date_dim_filtered dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
JOIN returns_base rb ON ws.ws_item_sk = rb.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = rb.wr_order_number
WHERE
  (
    (rb.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND rb.cd_education_status = 'Secondary' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
    OR (rb.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND rb.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
    OR (rb.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND rb.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
  )
  AND (
    (rb.ca_state IN ('AZ', 'CO', 'WA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
    OR (rb.ca_state = 'NY' AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
    OR (rb.ca_state IN ('OH', 'MI', 'FL') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
  );

WITH ss_filtered_by_addr AS (
    SELECT ss_sold_date_sk, ss_cdemo_sk, ss_hdemo_sk, ss_quantity, 
           ss_ext_sales_price, ss_ext_wholesale_cost, ss_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States' AND (
        (ca_state IN ('GA', 'AZ', 'WI') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200) OR
        (ca_state IN ('VA', 'CO', 'NJ') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300) OR
        (ca_state IN ('CA', 'FL', 'GA') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
    )
)
SELECT min(ss_quantity), min(ss_ext_sales_price), min(ss_ext_wholesale_cost), min(ss_ext_wholesale_cost)
FROM (
    SELECT ss.ss_quantity, ss.ss_ext_sales_price, ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost
    FROM ss_filtered_by_addr ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'D'
      AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Unknown'
      AND hd.hd_dep_count = 3
      AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
  UNION ALL
    SELECT ss.ss_quantity, ss.ss_ext_sales_price, ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost
    FROM ss_filtered_by_addr ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
      AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1
      AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
  UNION ALL
    SELECT ss.ss_quantity, ss.ss_ext_sales_price, ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost
    FROM ss_filtered_by_addr ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Unknown'
      AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1
      AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
) AS qualified_sales;

	s_name,
	n_name,
	p_partkey,
	p_mfgr,
	s_address,
	s_phone,
	s_comment
from
	part,

	region
where

	and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
	and p_size = 7
	and p_type like '%COPPER'
	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
	and r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'
	and ps_supplycost = (
		select
			min(ps_supplycost)
		from
			partsupp,
			supplier,
			nation,
			region
		where
			p_partkey = ps_partkey
			and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
			and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
			and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
			and r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'
	)
order by
	s_acctbal desc,
	n_name,
	s_name,
	p_partkey
limit 100;

select
    s.s_acctbal,
    s.s_name,
    n.n_name,
    p.p_partkey,
    p.p_mfgr,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    s.s_comment
from
    part p
    join partsupp ps on p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
    join (
        select 
            ps_1.ps_partkey,
            min(ps_1.ps_supplycost) as min_cost
        from 
            partsupp ps_1
            join supplier s_1 on ps_1.ps_suppkey = s_1.s_suppkey
            join nation n_1 on s_1.s_nationkey = n_1.n_nationkey
            join region r_1 on n_1.n_regionkey = r_1.r_regionkey
        where 
            r_1.r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'
        group by 
            ps_1.ps_partkey
    ) min_ps on ps.ps_partkey = min_ps.ps_partkey and ps.ps_supplycost = min_ps.min_cost
    join supplier s on ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    join nation n on s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    join region r on n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
where
    p.p_size = 7
    and p.p_type like '%COPPER'
    and r.r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'
order by

	sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue
from
	customer,
	orders,
	lineitem,
	supplier,
	nation,
	region
where
	c_custkey = o_custkey
	and l_orderkey = o_orderkey
	and l_suppkey = s_suppkey
	and c_nationkey = s_nationkey
	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
	and r_name = 'EUROPE'
	and o_orderdate >= date '1994-01-01'
	and o_orderdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year
group by
	n_name
order by
	revenue desc
limit 1;

	n.n_name,
	sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) as revenue
from
	region r
	join nation n on n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
	join customer c on c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
	join orders o on o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
		and o.o_orderdate >= date '1994-01-01'
		and o.o_orderdate < date '1995-01-01'
	join lineitem l on l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
	join supplier s on s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
		and s.s_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
where
	r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
group by
	n.n_name
order by
	revenue desc
limit 1;

		from

		where

				from

				where
					p_name like 'snow%'
			)
			and ps_availqty > (
				select
					0.5 * sum(l_quantity)
				from
					lineitem
				where
					l_partkey = ps_partkey
					and l_suppkey = ps_suppkey
					and l_shipdate >= date '1994-01-01'
					and l_shipdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year
			)
	)
	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_name = 'EGYPT'
order by
	s_name
limit 1;

with lineitem_agg as (
    select 
        l_partkey, 
        l_suppkey, 
        sum(l_quantity) * 0.5 as threshold_qty
    from lineitem
    where l_shipdate >= date '1994-01-01'
      and l_shipdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year
    group by l_partkey, l_suppkey
)
select
    s.s_name,
    s.s_address
from
    supplier s
    join nation n on s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
where
    n.n_name = 'EGYPT'
    and exists (
        select 1
        from partsupp ps
        join part p on ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
        join lineitem_agg li on ps.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey 
                            and ps.ps_suppkey = li.l_suppkey
        where 
            ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
            and p.p_name like 'snow%'
            and ps.ps_availqty > li.threshold_qty
    )
order by
    s.s_name
limit 1

	and p_brand = 'Brand#23'

	)

with filtered_parts as (
    select p_partkey 
    from part 
    where p_brand = 'Brand#23' and p_container = 'WRAP BAG'
),
part_avg_qty as (
    select l_partkey, 0.2 * avg(l_quantity) as avg_qty_threshold
    from lineitem
    where l_partkey in (select p_partkey from filtered_parts)
    group by l_partkey
)
select
    sum(l.l_extendedprice) / 7.0 as avg_yearly
from
    lineitem l
    join filtered_parts p on l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
    join part_avg_qty aq on l.l_partkey = aq.l_partkey and l.l_quantity < aq.avg_qty_threshold
limit 1

select
	s_name,
	count(*) as numwait
from
	supplier,
	lineitem l1,
	orders,
	nation
where
	s_suppkey = l1.l_suppkey
	and o_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey
	and o_orderstatus = 'F'
	and l1.l_receiptdate > l1.l_commitdate
	and exists (
		select
			*
		from
			lineitem l2
		where
			l2.l_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey
			and l2.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey
	)
	and not exists (
		select
			*
		from
			lineitem l3
		where
			l3.l_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey
			and l3.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey
			and l3.l_receiptdate > l3.l_commitdate
	)
	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_name = 'FRANCE'
group by
	s_name
order by
	numwait desc,
	s_name
limit 100;
q2:
SELECT 
    s.s_name,
    COUNT(*) AS numwait
FROM 
    supplier s
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey AND n.n_name = 'FRANCE'
    JOIN lineitem l1 ON s.s_suppkey = l1.l_suppkey AND l1.l_receiptdate > l1.l_commitdate
    JOIN orders o ON l1.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F'
    JOIN (
        SELECT l_orderkey
        FROM lineitem
        GROUP BY l_orderkey
        HAVING MIN(l_suppkey) <> MAX(l_suppkey)
    ) l2 ON l1.l_orderkey = l2.l_orderkey
    LEFT JOIN lineitem l3 ON l1.l_orderkey = l3.l_orderkey 
        AND l3.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey 
        AND l3.l_receiptdate > l3.l_commitdate
WHERE 
    l3.l_orderkey IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    s.s_name
ORDER BY 
    numwait DESC,
    s.s_name
LIMIT 100;

	sum(l_quantity) as sum_qty,
	sum(l_extendedprice) as sum_base_price,
	sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as sum_disc_price,
	sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) as sum_charge,
	avg(l_quantity) as avg_qty,
	avg(l_extendedprice) as avg_price,
	avg(l_discount) as avg_disc,
	count(*) as count_order
from
	lineitem
where
	l_shipdate <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '79 day'

	l_linestatus
order by
	l_returnflag,
	l_linestatus
limit 1;

    SELECT l_returnflag, l_linestatus
    FROM lineitem
    WHERE l_shipdate <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '79 day'
    GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
    ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    l.l_returnflag,
    l.l_linestatus,
    sum(l_quantity) as sum_qty,
    sum(l_extendedprice) as sum_base_price,

    sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) as sum_charge,
    avg(l_quantity) as avg_qty,
    avg(l_extendedprice) as avg_price,
    avg(l_discount) as avg_disc,
    count(*) as count_order

    lineitem l

    first_group fg ON l.l_returnflag = fg.l_returnflag AND l.l_linestatus = fg.l_linestatus

    l.l_shipdate <= date '1998-12-01' - interval '79 day'

			or o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH'

		else 0

		else 0

  AND lt.id = ml.link_type_id
  AND ml.movie_id = t.id
  AND t.id = mk.movie_id
  AND mk.keyword_id = k.id
  AND t.id = mc.movie_id

FROM aka_name AS an,

  AND n.name_pcode_cf BETWEEN 'A' AND 'F'
  AND (n.gender='m'

  AND pi.note IS NOT NULL
  AND t.production_year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
  AND n.id = an.person_id
  AND n.id = pi.person_id
  AND ci.person_id = n.id
  AND t.id = ci.movie_id
  AND ml.linked_movie_id = t.id
  AND lt.id = ml.link_type_id
  AND it.id = pi.info_type_id
  AND pi.person_id = an.person_id
  AND pi.person_id = ci.person_id
  AND an.person_id = ci.person_id

WHERE n.name_pcode_cf BETWEEN 'A' AND 'F'

    JOIN link_type AS lt ON lt.id = ml.link_type_id

WITH customer_total_return 
     AS (SELECT sr_customer_sk     AS ctr_customer_sk, 
                sr_store_sk        AS ctr_store_sk, 
                Sum(sr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return 
         FROM   store_returns, 
                date_dim 
         WHERE  sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND d_year = 2001 
         GROUP  BY sr_customer_sk, 
                   sr_store_sk) 
SELECT c_customer_id 
FROM   customer_total_return ctr1, 
       store, 
       customer 
WHERE  ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT Avg(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 
                                FROM   customer_total_return ctr2 
                                WHERE  ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk) 
       AND s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk 
       AND s_state = 'TN' 
       AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk 
ORDER  BY c_customer_id
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH customer_total_return_with_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        sr_customer_sk,
        SUM(sr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return,
        AVG(SUM(sr_return_amt)) OVER (PARTITION BY sr_store_sk) AS store_avg_return
    FROM 
        store_returns
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN 
        store ON sr_store_sk = s_store_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year = 2001 AND s_state = 'TN'
    GROUP BY 
        sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk
)
SELECT 
    c_customer_id
FROM 
    customer_total_return_with_avg
JOIN 
    customer ON sr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
WHERE 
    ctr_total_return > store_avg_return * 1.2
ORDER BY 
    c_customer_id
LIMIT 100;

SELECT cd_gender, 
               cd_marital_status, 
               cd_education_status, 
               Count(*) cnt1, 
               cd_purchase_estimate, 
               Count(*) cnt2, 
               cd_credit_rating, 
               Count(*) cnt3, 
               cd_dep_count, 
               Count(*) cnt4, 
               cd_dep_employed_count, 
               Count(*) cnt5, 
               cd_dep_college_count, 
               Count(*) cnt6 
FROM   customer c, 
       customer_address ca, 
       customer_demographics 
WHERE  c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk 
       AND ca_county IN ( 'Lycoming County', 'Sheridan County', 
                          'Kandiyohi County', 
                          'Pike County', 
                                           'Greene County' ) 
       AND cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk 
       AND EXISTS (SELECT * 
                   FROM   store_sales, 
                          date_dim 
                   WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk 
                          AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                          AND d_year = 2002 
                          AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 4 + 3) 
       AND ( EXISTS (SELECT * 
                     FROM   web_sales, 
                            date_dim 
                     WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk 
                            AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                            AND d_year = 2002 
                            AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 4 + 3) 
              OR EXISTS (SELECT * 
                         FROM   catalog_sales, 
                                date_dim 
                         WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk 
                                AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                                AND d_year = 2002 
                                AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 4 + 3) ) 
GROUP  BY cd_gender, 
          cd_marital_status, 
          cd_education_status, 
          cd_purchase_estimate, 
          cd_credit_rating, 
          cd_dep_count, 
          cd_dep_employed_count, 
          cd_dep_college_count 
ORDER  BY cd_gender, 
          cd_marital_status, 
          cd_education_status, 
          cd_purchase_estimate, 
          cd_credit_rating, 
          cd_dep_count, 
          cd_dep_employed_count, 
          cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100;

  SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk

  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 7
),
ws_cs_customers AS (
  SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 7
  UNION
  SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 7
)
SELECT
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
  cd_credit_rating,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt3,
  cd_dep_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt4,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt5,
  cd_dep_college_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt6
FROM ss_customers
JOIN ws_cs_customers ON ss_customers.ss_customer_sk = ws_cs_customers.customer_sk
JOIN customer c ON ss_customers.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
WHERE
  ca.ca_county IN (
    'Lycoming County',
    'Sheridan County',
    'Kandiyohi County',
    'Pike County',
    'Greene County'
  )
GROUP BY
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  cd_credit_rating,
  cd_dep_count,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  cd_credit_rating,
  cd_dep_count,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100;
